name: console-simulator
title: Console simulator block
description: Play the counterparty without ever reading as operator workflow: the console's only scrimmed drawer on a distinct dark surface with a persistent sandbox label, one third-person control per simulations call (a control phrased as an operator decision throws a developer error), a ledger check with a visible pass/fail surface, and a channel footer that states adapter, session and peers - and says in words when the surface is not actually sharing.
